review.access: Normal 2024 Wizard spell-list access; learn and prepare through the Wizard's normal rules.
review.scope: Listed mechanics checked against the official current entry or SRD 5.2.1. Tier and acquisition advice are Compendium editorial judgments, not official rules.

compendium.summary: Flexible non-concentration damage with a 2024 bouncing effect. Useful when selecting a damage type matters; less dependable than guaranteed damage or control for a critical turn.
warnings: Tier is a situational Compendium assessment, not a letter grade quoted from Pack Tactics.
tactics: A ranged spell attack deals 3d8 of the selected type on a hit. Matching damage dice can cause a leap to a different target within 30 feet, requiring another attack.
Each higher slot adds 1d8 and raises the leap cap to the slot level. Do not budget every possible bounce as guaranteed damage; each creature can be targeted only once per casting.
